maddeler.e:
يتبحبحوا (form IIq)
# يَتَبَحْبَحُوا (yatabaḥbaḥū) /ja.ta.baħ.ba.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# يُتَبَحْبَحُوا (yutabaḥbaḥū) /ju.ta.baħ.ba.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
